title: RiderSaathi shuru kaise karein
summary: RiderSaathi install karne se lekar pehli ride tak: sign in, permissions, rules, Monitor mode aur Active mode configure karne ka step by step aasan driver guide.
content:
1. Download aur Install

Sabse pehle hamari website se RiderSaathi APK download karein aur install karein. Agar Play Protect warning aaye to 'More details' par tap karke 'Install anyway' karein.

2. Mobile Number se Login

RiderSaathi kholo aur apna active mobile number darj karo. Pehli 10 rides bilkul free milengi.

3. Zaroori Permissions dein

Accessibility Service on karein taaki app booking card padh sake, aur 'Display over other apps' on karein floating controller ke liye.

4. Apne Rules Tay Karein

Booking type, Trip distance, Pickup limit aur Fare range set karein.

5. Pehle Monitor mode, phir Active

Pehli ek shift Monitor mode me chala kar dekhein ki app kya faisla le raha hai. Sab theek lage to Active mode on kar dein.

title: Booking types — kaunsi bookings leni hain
summary: RiderSaathi me Bike, Auto, Cab aur Parcel ke switch, Boost/Saver rides, cab ke types aur Intercity bookings kaise chalu-band karein uski step by step guide.
content:
Aapke paas poora control hai ki kaunsi ride leni hai:

  • Parcel ya Sawari: Agar aaj sirf parcel lena hai to sawari band kar sakte hain.
  • Boost & Saver Switch: Kam kiraye wali Boost/Saver rides alag switch se block ki ja sakti hain.
  • Cab Options: AC, Non-AC, XL aur Intercity ke alag switch hain.

title: Trip distance aur pickup distance
summary: Trip distance (kam se kam aur zyada se zyada km) aur pickup limit kaise set karein taaki sirf faydemand rides hi auto-accept hon, poora tutorial yahan padhein.
content:
Rules me Trip Distance aur Pickup Distance do sabse mahatvapoorna settings hain:

  • Minimum Trip: Chhoti ghaate wali (jaise ₹20-₹30) rides se bachne ke liye minimum 4 ya 5 km rakhein.
  • Maximum Trip: Jitni lambi ride aap lena chahein (jaise 30 km ya 50 km).
  • Pickup Distance: 2.5 se 3.5 km shuruaat ke liye behtareen rehta hai.

title: Kamai filter — fare aur extra tip
summary: Kamai filter me minimum fare kaise rakhein, Rapido bike card rule aur customer tip wali rides ko preference dene ki poori jankari iss driver guide me padhein.
content: Kamai filter aapko target earnings set karne deta hai. Minimum fare tay karein taaki sirf profitable bookings hi accept hon. Tip switch on karne par surge ya customer tip wali rides ko preference milti hai.

title: Go To — jidhar jaana hai
summary: Shift ke aakhir me ghar ki taraf jaane wali rides lene ke liye Go To area feature kaise set karein aur khali wapas aane ke nuksan se kaise bachein, seekhein.
content: Shift khatam hone par khaali ghar lautna nuksaan hai. Go To feature me apne area ka naam daalein. RiderSaathi sirf usi taraf jaane wali rides accept karega, aur timer poora hone par Go To automatically band ho jaata hai.

title: Jahan nahi jaana (Area Block)
summary: Heavy traffic jam, kharab raste ya unsafe areas ko pickup aur drop dono taraf se block karne ke liye RiderSaathi area block rules step by step setup karein.
content: Shehar ke jin ilaakon me jaam lagta hai ya wapas aana mushkil hota hai, unhe block list me daal dein. RiderSaathi un jagahon ki rides ko reject kar dega.

title: Raste wali agli ride
summary: Current ride ke dauraan drop location ke raste me aane wali agli booking automatically accept karein aur fuel aur samay dono bacha kar zyada kamai karein.
content: Jab aap passenger drop karne wale hote hain, tab ride app agli booking offer karta hai. RiderSaathi wahi booking chunta hai jo aapke usi ongoing raste par ho, taaki aapka samay aur fuel dono bache.

title: RiderSaathi kin apps par chalta hai
summary: Rapido Captain (bike, auto, cab, parcel), Uber Driver aur Porter Delivery Partner ke saath RiderSaathi app compatibility aur features ki poori detail dekhein.
content: RiderSaathi Rapido Captain, Uber Driver aur Porter Delivery Partner teeno ke saath safely chalta hai. Ola par auto-accept band hai isliye Ola support nahi karta.
